_doc: Fail-safe allowlist for Medic's PR2 reversible action handlers in scripts/medic_actions.py. This is the ONLY set of targets Medic may mutate; a target not listed here is REFUSED and Medic escalates a diagnose-only report instead of acting on an arbitrary unit. STAGE 2 (auto-restart ACTIVE): restart_daemon_units and retrigger_inbox_targets are now populated -- the 'Medic restart coordination guard vs watchdog' (Stage 2, _recent_peer_restart) has shipped, so Medic may restart these watcher units only after refusing when a peer (watchdog flap / a recent watchdog-or-systemd restart) is already managing the unit. The auto-restart tier overlaps systemd Restart=on-failure and the watchdog's own restart logic, which is exactly why the coordination guard exists: Medic fills the 'systemd gave up, no peer active' gap and defers otherwise. An empty restart/retrigger allowlist (the prior Stage 1) REFUSED every restart-daemon / retrigger-inbox / retrigger-watcher classification (not-permitted, escalate diagnose-only); these arrays were the fail-safe brake and are repopulated now that the guard is live. restart_daemon_units (Stage 2): the watchdog-supervised daemon units Medic may restart via 'sudo -n systemctl restart <unit>' -- mirrors scripts/watchdog.py AUTO_RESTART_SERVICES, the only units the watchdog itself auto-restarts (ourliberty-inbox-watcher.service, ourliberty-outbox-notifier.service). retrigger_inbox_targets (Stage 2): the inbox-stall remediation target -- the existing re-trigger mechanism in this repo IS restarting the inbox-watcher (scripts/watchdog.py check_inbox_watcher), so a stalled inbox is re-triggered by restarting ourliberty-inbox-watcher.service. silenceable_subjects (LIVE in Stage 1): substring patterns of alert fingerprints (source:subject) that Medic's silence-false-positive handler may durably suppress WITHOUT DMing Larry, but ONLY after its read-only investigation confirms the specific fingerprint is benign (e.g. a forge-no-pr alert whose build shipped under a re-keyed branch -- the 2026-06-04 forge-queue-api case). The silence tier has ZERO overlap with the watchdog (the watchdog never silences), is fully reversible, and mutates nothing on the system, so it is safe to enable ahead of the restart coordination guard. A fingerprint matching no pattern is REFUSED. Seed ONLY classes proven to produce benign false positives; the durable healer-side reconciliation (e.g. _preflight_family_shipped) is always the preferred fix, this is the backstop. A silence is reversible via larry_alerts.unsilence. Seeded conservatively. Missing or malformed file is treated as an EMPTY allowlist -- Medic can act on/silence nothing -- fail safe, never raises. Unit names carry the full .service suffix.
